name: Worldforged Stoneflow Handwraps pickup stands on the ground and opens (#4147)
contract: #4147 reports the Stoneflow Handwraps box (gameobject entry 518319, guid 6941159) buried mostly underground. rev_20261016_90_worldforged_in_game_position_check moves it to (-6731.1, -2052.8, 346.2) on map 0, the spot read in game with .gps. The pickup must stand within one yard of the ground at that spot and open for loot when a player at the spot uses it. The map is taken from the neighbouring Searing Gorge rows of the same SQL file and is not independently verified.
